claim: The Party plans in Five-Year blocks and aims at 2049, the centennial of the People's Republic.
source: [1] Successive Five-Year Plan outlines, National Development and Reform Commission, nested inside the 2049 centenary framing. Published and continuous.

claim: It ran the Thousand Talents recruitment for sixteen years before Western agencies treated it as one campaign.
source: [2] U.S. Senate Permanent Subcommittee on Investigations, *Threats to the U.S. Research Enterprise: China's Talent Recruitment Plans* (November 2019).

claim: The Party took the security files of twenty-one and a half million people, and across three administrations the United States imposed no lasting penalty.
source: [3] U.S. Office of Personnel Management, cybersecurity incident disclosures (2015); House Committee on Oversight and Government Reform, *The OPM Data Breach* (September 2016).

claim: The Committee on Public Information closed its doors before 1919 was out.
source: [4] Executive Order 2594 establishing the Committee on Public Information, April 13, 1917; Executive Order 3154 abolishing it, 1919. NARA Record Group 63.

claim: Chinese brokers sell precursors to Mexican cartels, the cartels make the drug, and it killed 48,422 Americans in 2024, down more than a third from the 76,282 of the year before, while the supplier keeps a layer of deniability between itself and the dead.
source: [5] CDC WONDER mortality database, deaths involving synthetic opioids other than methadone. **Verified:** 48,422 (2024); 76,282 (2023). **Corrected from draft**, which gave the peak as "near a hundred thousand two years earlier" — that figure conflates fentanyl-specific deaths with total overdose deaths from all substances, and the peak was one year earlier, not two.

claim: The fight over one app ran through executive orders, court injunctions, four congressional committees, and state laws, burned five years, and ended with a hundred and seventy million American users still on it.
source: [6] Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act, April 24, 2024. User figures from the company's own statements to Congress.

claim: The United States Strategic Bombing Survey, compiled after the war from German production records, found that Germany did not fully mobilize its economy for total war until 1943, four years after the invasion of Poland, because competing party and military authorities protected overlapping mandates rather than surrender them to a central plan.
source: [7] *United States Strategic Bombing Survey*, European Report (1945).

claim: The United Front runs a star of influence, working more than six hundred overseas groups from one hub.
source: [8] United Front Work Department published structure and remit. **Scoped:** organization counts vary by definition and source; the text states the order of magnitude rather than a precise figure.

claim: Executive Order 9024 created the War Production Board and Executive Order 8807 created the Office of Scientific Research and Development, both imposing central coordination on an economy and a research establishment that had never operated that way and would not choose to again.
source: [9] Executive Order 9024 (War Production Board, January 1942); Executive Order 8807 (OSRD, June 1941).

claim: FBI Director Christopher Wray told Congress under oath in January 2024 that the resulting threat was the defining threat of a generation.
source: [10] Christopher Wray, testimony before the House Select Committee on the Chinese Communist Party, January 31, 2024.

claim: Part One showed Scott choosing blockade over the decisive battle his critics demanded, and the Supreme Court sanctioning strangulation as an instrument of state.
source: [11] *The Prize Cases*, 67 U.S. 635 (1863). Full treatment in Part One, Chapter 1.

claim: Mao formalized the same logic on the other side of the world seventy-six years later, in *On Guerrilla Warfare*, instructing forces to concentrate against weakness, disperse against strength, and decline any engagement the stronger side is trying to force.
source: [12] Mao Zedong, *On Guerrilla Warfare* (1937).

claim: Major universities draw a substantial share of some revenues from Chinese students and research ties, and the behavior follows the money.
source: [13] Higher Education Act Section 117 foreign gift disclosures. **Scoped:** the draft gave "fifteen to twenty-five percent of some revenues," which no single source supports across institutions. Revised to a qualitative claim pending institution-level figures.

claim: About a quarter of China scholars report that they censor themselves.
source: [14] Greitens and Truex, "Repressive Experiences among China Scholars," *The China Quarterly* (2020).

claim: The Lend-Lease Act, which became law in March 1941, nine months before Pearl Harbor, let Washington supply Britain, and later the Soviet Union and dozens of other governments, with material the recipients could not have purchased and did not have to repay in the ordinary sense.
source: [15] Lend-Lease Act, Pub. L. 77-11, March 11, 1941.

claim: Require real-time public disclosure of foreign funding above a set line for universities, think tanks, nonprofits, and media, so the hidden dependence becomes an open one that critics can weigh.
source: [16] Foreign Agents Registration Act filings; Higher Education Act Section 117.

claim: Two hundred seventy-two words, delivered at a cemetery dedication in November 1863, did more to align a divided public behind a war's purpose than any order could have.
source: [17] Gettysburg Address, November 19, 1863. **Verified:** 272 words in the Bliss copy.

claim: Land to the tiller, the promise of redistributing farmland to the peasants who worked it, was practiced in the base areas through the war against Japan and codified nationally in the Agrarian Reform Law of 1950.
source: [18] Agrarian Reform Law of the People's Republic of China, June 1950.

claim: Mao's 1942 talks at the Yan'an Forum on Literature and Art laid the doctrinal foundation for treating culture as an instrument of alignment rather than a private pursuit, a doctrine that still governs Chinese film and publishing regulation today.
source: [19] Mao Zedong, *Talks at the Yan'an Forum on Literature and Art* (1942).

claim: The Party held the text of the National Security Law secret until the hour it took effect, then inside hours and days the arrests, the frozen accounts, the pulled apps, the pressure on media, and the dismissals all landed together.
source: [20] Law of the People's Republic of China on Safeguarding National Security in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, effective June 30, 2020. Full treatment in Part Five.

claim: Part One showed Grant attacking in every theater at once in 1864, denying Lee the option of reinforcing one front by weakening another, and the Normandy planners fixing five beaches to a single dawn eighty years later.
source: [21] Ulysses S. Grant, *Personal Memoirs*; *Official Records of the War of the Rebellion*, 1864 campaign orders. Neptune/Overlord operational orders for the Normandy timing. Full treatment in Part One.

claim: The Liberty Loan campaigns of 1917 and 1918 recruited movie stars, printed posters by the millions, and built a social environment in which not owning a bond looked like something a neighbor would notice, until purchase rates climbed far higher than any tax could have compelled by force.
source: [22] Liberty Loan campaign records, U.S. Treasury; NARA Record Group 53.

claim: It controls the large majority of the world's rare-earth processing capacity, and it showed the leverage in 2010, when a dispute with Japan led it to halt rare-earth exports and pressure Japanese high-technology manufacturing into a fast climbdown.
source: [23] U.S. Geological Survey, *Mineral Commodity Summaries*, annual, for processing concentration. **Scoped:** the draft gave "about eighty percent," which varies by processing stage and year. Revised to a qualitative claim; specify the stage and year if a figure is restored.

claim: Taiwan makes the overwhelming majority of the world's most advanced logic chips, so any break there cascades into a global technology collapse, a tipping point so severe it shapes the plans of every major power.
source: [24] **Scoped:** the draft gave "about ninety-two percent," which is accurate for leading-edge logic capacity but not for semiconductor manufacturing generally. Text now specifies advanced logic.

claim: Investigators found the group had lived inside the systems of a small Massachusetts utility, the Littleton Electric Light and Water Department, for nearly ten months before the FBI called to say so, and after a 2024 operation disrupted part of its infrastructure, the group rebuilt and kept operating.
source: [25] CISA and NSA joint advisories on Volt Typhoon; Littleton Electric Light and Water Department disclosure (2025).

claim: The earlier campaign against ball-bearing plants, though it destroyed real capacity, never produced a comparable collapse, because the Germans dispersed production and found substitutes faster than the campaign could close every avenue.
source: [26] *United States Strategic Bombing Survey*, oil and ball-bearing campaign analyses.

claim: The 2015 Made in China 2025 notice names, in the state's own words, the specific sectors — semiconductors, aerospace, biotechnology — chosen because a gain in any one of them cascades into every industry built on top of it.
source: [27] State Council, *Made in China 2025* notice (2015).

claim: Four decades later, a federal commission examining the record concluded that military necessity had never justified the decision, and Congress passed formal redress in 1988.
source: [28] Executive Order 9066, February 19, 1942; *Korematsu v. United States*, 323 U.S. 214 (1944); Commission on Wartime Relocation and Internment of Civilians, *Personal Justice Denied* (1983); Civil Liberties Act of 1988.

claim: The prison medical system withheld real care until he died in custody.
source: [29] Charter 08 (2008); Nobel Peace Prize 2010; Liu Xiaobo died in custody July 13, 2017.
